note: The PDA's own layer over openzone-core/ui/tokens.json, read after it (build.tokens in dayz-mcp.toml). Players type Ukrainian into the PDA, and the vanilla bitmap Metron faces draw the Cyrillic capital I (U+0406) blank; etelkatextpro carries it, with Ї Є Ґ (skill gui-layouts.md section 25). Every PDA edit box and every OZ_Unwrap ruler take their face from `field`, so the box and its ruler stay the same face.
